findings.text: follow-on: the lane-paused payload emits error, detail, reason and lane_gate but no picker_selection, so a picker-routed local refusal reports as though the picker never ran; the reviewed node was fenced from cli.py and recorded this under follow_ons, and the reviewed change itself does not touch it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base ade36b77d; three commits add one 74-line test file and a one-line landing anchor, changing no production source, which the contract permits where the guarded behaviour is already correct.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks to state where the lane gate runs relative to the picker, to keep the gate on a picker-chosen local lane, and to add four cases in tests/test_congested_local_lane_still_reaches_the_picker.py; the manifest records the ordering, the four cases are present, and I reproduced 4 passed EXIT=0 at head.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a no-lane dispatch reaches the picker even when the local lane is congested; at head the CLI runs picker.pick before plan_dispatch resolves a backend, so the metered route (beta) launches with picker_selection.backend==beta while the picker's local route (alpha) and an explicit --local both refuse lane-paused with lane_gate.allowance==0, showing Jev's pick is not pre-empted by local admission.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits 321f0f83a, a6bfec0d4 and 762d6158, changed_paths as the test file and the fragment, base-gate.log 327 passed EXIT=0, head-gate.log 331 passed EXIT=0, negative-control.log EXIT=1, and a follow_ons line naming the cli.py payload omission.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the delta ade36b77d..762d6158 changes only tests/test_congested_local_lane_still_reaches_the_picker.py and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/congested-local-lane-reaches-the-picker.html, both inside the declared write paths; reckon/crew/dispatch.py was declared but needed no change because head's copy already asks the picker before plan_dispatch.

justifications.durability: the negative control inverts the ordering and 3 of 4 cases fail (beta, alpha, hold), so the guard is not vacuous; only the explicit --local case is insensitive.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_congested_local_lane_still_reaches_the_picker.py:61 asserts the four exit codes and payload fields, I reproduced 4 passed EXIT=0 at head, and the negative control records 3 failed 1 passed EXIT=1 when the local allowance runs before the picker.
justifications.fit: the file reuses tests/test_dispatch_names_its_backend CONFIG and _arguments through deepcopy and pytest_plugins and stubs picker.pick with a SimpleNamespace, matching the existing dispatch-fixture style; the plugin declaration in a test module is a mild departure from convention.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckoning/crew/dispatch.py:6767 asks dispatch_picker_selection before plan_dispatch at :6780, and the new file pins the outcome at the CLI for both a metered and a local pick, so goal_fidelity is met by proof rather than by a production edit.
justifications.reuse: the case combines an existing congestion lane document with the existing picker-routing stub instead of forking a fixture, and no existing test already covers congestion across the four routing outcomes.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the ade36b77d..762d6158 delta (the test file and the fragment anchor) is inside the declared write paths; the declared reckon/crew/dispatch.py was already correct and was correctly left unedited.
